## PR Checklist (aligns with DoD)

- [ ] Lint passes (`golangci-lint`)
- [ ] Tests pass (`go test ./...`)
- [ ] Coverage ≥ 80% or baseline not decreased
- [ ] Swagger annotations updated and `swag init` artifacts committed (if API changed)
- [ ] `govulncheck` shows no new High/Critical vulns
- [ ] No secrets in code; env vars documented
- [ ] Performance considerations addressed (no N+1, acceptable latency)
- [ ] Docs updated (README/module) as needed
- [ ] At least one reviewer approval
- [ ] QA sign-off (if applicable)
